description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance on a UNITED multi-loft RECT-cross-section torus.
rationale: Locks in Phase C-heavy (Path 2c, _filaments_from_section_planes) for the case that triggered Kubota's 2026-04-28 work-in-progress: united multi-loft solid with NON-circular cross-section. Tier 1 (UV-map) trips because the lateral surface is fragmented across the unite() boolean. Tier 2 (per-station faces) trips because the end-cap faces don't survive unite. Tier 2b (circle-edge per-station) trips because there are no CIRCLE edges in the rect cross-section. Before v4.24.0, Tier 3 (longest-edge equivalent-circle) returned NaN for this case (cross_section_radius_m fell to 0 because area extraction failed). Phase C-heavy added Path 2c which sections the solid at n_stations along a rotation-axis-derived spine, recovers the cross-section faces, and reuses Tier 2's per-station-faces filament placement. Result: 138 nH (vs analytic Grover-DC 177 nH and equiv-circle DC 165 nH; the 138 nH thin-skin number is below the DC formulas because perimeter-only filaments capture the thin-skin (high-frequency) limit where current is on the rect perimeter only -- the DC formulas assume uniform current fill). Verified 2026-05-02 across n_peri = 8 / 16 / 32 / 48: L plateaus at 139-141 nH.

sample.comment: Synthetic fixture (build123d Solid.make_loft + fuse). Spine: 355deg arc R=50mm; cross-section: 8mm radial x 6mm vertical rect; 13 loft profiles -> 12 ruled lofts -> united into one solid. 113 KB. Cubit-equivalent .jou: validation_test/panels/golden/rect_torus_lofted_united.jou (not maintained; the build123d script is the source of truth: tools/make_phase_c_rect_torus.py).

physics.coil: 1-loop 355deg torus, R=50mm, rect cross-section 8x6mm, united multi-loft

expected.comment_2026_05_20_post_shim_fix: Updated 145.3 -> 191.5 nH after task #30 fixes 3 bugs in _filaments_from_section_planes that surfaced when the build123d -> OCP shim landed in v4.56.0: (1) centroids_attempted contract violation -- the caller was passing path_m (spine point at bbox-heuristic R) as 'centroid' but _filaments_from_per_station_faces requires face.center() so cad_to_m = span_m/span_cad recovers cleanly (was 0.928 ~ R_spine/R_face, silently shrinking UV by 8 %); (2) is_open dispatch was routing to _centerline_from_open_spine (rim tracer for coils with straight LEADS), wrong for swept geometries with cap_a/cap_b -- use _gen_spine planar arc; (3) _parallel_transport_frame returns v_hat aligned with chord-perpendicular (~9 deg off radial at n_stations=20), shrinking the rect's radial extent by cos(9 deg) ~ 1.5 %.  After these fixes, filaments sit at the loft's actual interior face centroids (R = 45.0 - 52.8 mm; bundle center at R ~ 48.85 mm; the loft's interpolation puts interior cross-section centroids at R = 48.4 - 49.7 instead of 50, with 46.5 mm^2 area instead of 48 -- a known imperfection of build123d Solid.make_loft + fuse).  L = 191.5 nH is what PEEC-perimeter produces on the actual (slightly imperfect) loft geometry.  BEM-A intree gives 153 nH (surface RWG captures rect-corner current crowding which PEEC-perimeter cannot); analytical thin-wire at R=50 with r_GMD~3 mm gives 176 nH.  The 145.3 -> 191.5 jump is the CORRECTION of pre-shim PEEC's coincidence (filaments at bbox-spine R=45.9 happened to give L close to BEM-A) to post-shim PEEC's actual behavior on the recovered geometry.  PEEC-perimeter remains imperfect for rect cross-sections vs BEM-A; this golden locks the corrected-PEEC result, NOT the physically-most-accurate value.

regression_guard.comment: Hard band around the post-shim corrected-PEEC 191.5 nH.  Pre-v4.24.0 result on this geometry was NaN (catastrophic failure: cross_section_radius_m=0 from longest-edge spine catching a lateral edge).  Pre-2026-05-02 it was 138 nH (filament 14 deg short of caps).  2026-05-02 cap-aware spine fix: 145.3 nH (filaments inadvertently at bbox-spine R=45.9 instead of conductor R=50, but happened to land near BEM-A's 153 nH).  v4.56.0 OCP shim: ValueError (rim tracer mis-segments cap_a, task #30).  v4.61.0 (this commit, 2026-05-20) task #30 fix-forward: 191.5 nH (filaments at actual face centroids, frame aligned with radial direction).  If this test starts returning > 200 or < 180 the post-shim fixes in _filaments_from_section_planes have regressed.
